stories.title: Lost a horse? Police in Flint Mountain are trying to find its owner
stories.summary: A horse has been found wandering on a road at Flint Mountain and North Wales Police are trying to track down its owner. The force’s North Flintshire neighbourhood policing team said they had received multiple calls from members of the public who had spotted the horse in the road. The animal has now been secured.
